Painterly bitmap illustration with tactile shading, NOT flat vectors or CSS-like outlines. Small restrained engraved flourishes in the metal. Clean silhouette readable at about 90px tall in a browser game.
No cork, no stopper, no lid or cap above the socket, no bottle mouth, no loop, chain, dangling hook or rope. No compass, no surrounding scenery, no shadow plane, no labels, numbers or writing, no watermarks. Real alpha transparency outside the complete fixture.
